preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit() or x.lstrip('-').isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5). The second line contains N space-separated integers (each -10^9 ≤ Ai ≤ 10^9). The third line is an integer X (0 ≤ X ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost to make all elements in the array ≥ 0.

postconditions.expression: all(int(Ai) >= 0 for Ai in array) and (min_cost == min(sum(max(0, -Ai) for Ai in array), sum(max(0, -Ai) for Ai in array) // X * X + sum(max(0, -Ai) % X for Ai in array)))
postconditions.description: The minimal cost is the minimum between (1) the cost of applying the second operation individually to each negative element, and (2) the cost of applying the first operation as many times as possible (floor division) and then applying the second operation to the remaining negative elements.
